title: Payroll
subtitle: Employees, their salaries and the monthly payroll

noAccess.title: No access to payroll
noAccess.body: Salaries are confidential: ask the clinic owner if you need payroll.

errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

run.earlier_one: {{count}} earlier month still has pending lines:
run.earlier_other: {{count}} earlier months still have pending lines:
run.emptyTitle: No one on payroll this month
run.emptyBody: Add the clinic's employees: dentists are paid through Compensation.
run.skipBody: No salary is paid for this month (unpaid leave, paid elsewhere). You can undo it.
run.voidBody: The payment and its salary expense are voided; the line is pending again to be confirmed correctly.

adjust.title: Adjust {{name}} · {{month}}
adjust.body: Bonuses add, deductions subtract; Other is signed. Net pay never goes below zero.
adjust.label: Label
adjust.negative: Deductions are larger than the salary

problems.label: Give it a label
problems.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero
problems.signed: Enter an amount other than zero

confirmMany.body: Each net is shown with its adjustments. One confirmation records every payment and its salary expense.
confirmMany.future: The date can't be in the future

employees.emptyBody: Add reception, assistants and everyone else the clinic pays monthly. Dentists are paid through Compensation.

employee.leaveBody: Their last payroll line is the month they left. Nothing is pro-rated: adjust that line if needed.
employee.removeBody: Only for someone added by mistake: they have no payroll yet.

notice.deactivated: {{user}} was deactivated. The employee stays active until you mark them as left.
notice.dentist: {{user}} is now a dentist. Dentists are paid through Compensation: unlink or mark the employee as left.

problems.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero
problems.payrollFrom: Payroll starts on or after the hire month
problems.endDate: They left on or after the day they were hired

salary.title: Salary history
salary.changeBody: The new salary applies from its month on. The old one stays in the history; months already paid keep what was paid.

payroll.staff_not_found: This staff user is not part of the clinic.
payroll.dentist_not_linkable: Dentists are paid through Compensation and cannot be linked to an employee.
payroll.user_already_linked: This user is already linked to another employee.
payroll.month_paid: Payroll is already paid for that month: the new salary must start after it.
payroll.paid_outside_employment: A paid month would fall outside these dates.
payroll.invalid_dates: Check the dates: payroll starts on or after the hire month, and leaving comes after hiring.
payroll.not_employed: There is no payroll line for that month.
payroll.line_not_pending: This line is no longer pending: refresh to see it.
payroll.no_salary: This employee has no salary for that month yet.
payroll.net_not_positive: The net pay is zero: skip the line instead.
payroll.net_negative: Deductions are larger than the salary.
payroll.stale: This line changed since you opened it: review it and confirm again.
payroll.future_date: The payment date can't be in the future.
payroll.not_removable: This employee has payroll: mark them as left instead.
payroll.idempotency_mismatch: This form was already sent with other values: reopen it and try again.
